_comment: Render graph Phase 0 baseline cameras. Run: <Host>.exe -capture-frame 600 -camera <name> [-scene:<file>] (see docs/perf/README.md). Player-anchored eye/target are offsets from the possessed body; world ones are positions. World positions here are first guesses: in Sandbox, Profiler (P) -> 'Log camera as capture preset' prints the current view as a line to paste. Changing a preset invalidates its baselines.

presets.name: camouflage
presets.note: Looks at the player's body so the camouflage pass is on screen

presets.name: underwater
presets.note: PLACEHOLDER x/z: move over open water. Heights are relative to the water level

presets.name: default
presets.note: The Editor's own start view; pass -scene:level.json for a real scene
